reason: S1 adds WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__YA_NONPREMUL as a newly supported source and destination format, but H0's pixfmts array omits that identifier. Consequently fuzz_swizzle_interleaved_from_slice can never select YA_NONPREMUL for src_pixfmt or dst_pixfmt, so prepare__ya_nonpremul and all new YA swizzle implementations are unreachable. fuzz_swizzle_ycck likewise cannot select YA_NONPREMUL as dst_pixfmt, leaving the new YA destination branch untested. This gap did not exist in S0 because those YA support paths were introduced by S1.
evidence: H0 derives both dst_pixfmt and src_pixfmt exclusively from the pixfmts array in fuzz_swizzle_interleaved_from_slice.
H0's pixfmts contains Y, Y_16BE, indexed, BGR, BGRA, RGB, and RGBA formats, but not WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__YA_NONPREMUL.
S1 adds a WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__YA_NONPREMUL case to wuffs_base__pixel_swizzler__prepare, dispatching to the new wuffs_private_impl__pixel_swizzler__prepare__ya_nonpremul.
S1 adds multiple YA_NONPREMUL conversion implementations for both WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_BLEND__SRC and WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_BLEND__SRC_OVER.
H0's fuzz_swizzle_ycck also derives dst_pixfmt from the same pixfmts array, while S1 newly admits YA_NONPREMUL in wuffs_base__pixel_swizzler__swizzle_ycck.
S1 adds YA_NONPREMUL cases to wuffs_base__pixel_buffer__color_u32_at and wuffs_base__pixel_buffer__set_color_u32_at, but H0 constructs no YA_NONPREMUL pixel buffer.
recommended_action: Add WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__YA_NONPREMUL to H0's pixfmts array so fuzz_swizzle_interleaved_from_slice exercises it as both source and destination with SRC and SRC_OVER, and fuzz_swizzle_ycck exercises it as a destination.
